title: Harry Turner investigates UAP sightings at Maralinga

tellings.quote: And he was invited to investigate multiple UAP UAP sightings that took place at Maralinga during the sightings.

plain: A man named Harry Turner was invited to look into several sightings of UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, at Maralinga in Australia, a remote site used for weapons tests, in the 1950s or 60s. Ross Coulthart, who has researched the subject, tells this without naming a source, and he also mentions the Australian UFO researcher Bill Chalker. If true, it would mean unexplained objects were being seen, and quietly investigated, at one of the country's most sensitive sites.
